title: The Box Is Big
lines: Tim and Val have a big box.
"Can it be in the bin?" said Val.
Tim tips the box in. It can not fit.
"A lot of bags are in the bin," said Val.
Tim digs in the bin and tips a bag up.
Tim tips the box up. It fits in the bin!
"It fits!" said Tim, and Val nods.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
